statements.statement: A member said the town passed a large override last year and the reported unspent school funds are part of that override money.
On top of the override, the town gave the schools an additional appropriation this year toward their budget.
Net additional state aid came in across various sources, with no decision yet on whether or how to distribute it.
Chapter 90 road funding increased this year, roughly doubling the town's allocation.
The town manager said the town has been told to expect at least this percentage increase in health insurance costs, which constrains how much other budget lines can grow.

warnings.about: the $5 million Nashoba-area state fire-district funding
warnings.condition: unless and until funding can be firmly relied upon in future years
warnings.prediction: the town will not commit permanent staff funded by this one-time money
